digest.component_or_area: rebar lifecycle policies and public surfaces
propositions: Enable verify.enforce_plan_material_pins and verify.require_plan_review_for_close in rebar.toml while retaining false defaults in reusable schema

End-to-end lifecycle tests must prove direct and transitive invalidation only after narrow material changes, unchanged re-review produces no propagation, and depends_on/blocks normalize to one canonical prerequisite
Rebar policies enabled while legacy unpinned attestations continue to pass both gates, and stale material-pin drift rejects operations with stale-pin-drift reason
Execution adaptation, in_progress-to-open reset, code-only close freshness, enable/disable/re-enable cycles, and deleted/archived target handling proven through public lifecycle surfaces
No eager backfill, graph-wide invalidation event, new pin command, list-output change, or stored relation migration introduced

Four real no-bypass fixture CLI cases must demonstrate legacy claim success, current pins close success, stale pin rejection, and missing close-plan review rejection with deterministic exit codes, status transitions, and reason tokens
